name: Stinger v2
code:
sheet({title:'Stinger v2', units:'in'})

// the 18 x 18 x 18 sizing box: corner at x=0, y=0, z=0; 18 along x, 18 along y, 18 tall
box(0,0,0, 18,18,18, {fill:C.white, alpha:0.15})

// Chasis plate: 17 x 17 x 0.25. bottom at Z = 1, centered in the box (0.5 in maegin each side)
box(0.5,0.5,1,  17,17,0.25, {fill:C.alu})
// dim(point A, point B, {off: how far to push the line out, in screen pixel})
dim([0.5,0.5,1], [17.5,0.5,1], {off:40})
dim([0.5,0.5,1], [0.5,17.5,1], {off: 40})
dim([0.5,0.5,1], [0.5,0.5,1.25], {off: 40})

// wheels: axel starts at x=0, y= 2.5, Z = 1.89; radius 1.89, 1.5 wide, axel along X
cyl(0,15,1.89, 1.89,1.5, {axis:'x', fill:C.dark})
cyl(0,2.5,1.89, 1.89,1.5, {axis:'x', fill:C.dark})
cyl(17.5,2.5,1.89, 1.89,1.5, {axis:'x', fill:C.dark})
cyl(17.5,15,1.89, 1.89,1.5, {axis:'x', fill:C.dark})
